title: The pre-install import graph uses Node built-ins only
statement: A static check of the setup command's import graph, up to and including the dependency-install step, finds no import of any installed dependency. Adding a top-level import of the Pi runtime or the validator makes that check fail.
notes: PASS 2026-09-22 on EVD-0133, slice 1 of TSK-0060. The setup command's static import graph, walked from bin/setup.mjs through every relative import transitively, reaches six node: built-ins and five Kiln modules (content-root, dependency-freshness, lock, setup-transaction, initialize-project) and no installed package at any depth. The scan is itself checked: a top-level `import Ajv from "ajv/dist/2020.js"` and an import of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent are both caught by it, so the criterion's second sentence is measured rather than assumed. Everything installed — Ajv through runtime-records, the state library, the initializer, the ignore owner — is imported dynamically after the install step, which is D26's order. The check runs in the full suite on all four CI cells. It is evaluated from this slice because the criterion is about the graph up to and including the install, and that part of the command is complete; the later slices can only add dynamic imports, and the same check guards them.
